title: Amplifier
text: Complex baseband model of amplifier with noise and nonlinearities, 1 input, 1 output, {Specify noise type} sets Noise representation; {Model} sets the amplifier, {Linear power gain (dB)}, {Type of Non-Linearity} sets the third, {IIP3 (dBm)} sets the input third-order, {OIP3 (dBm)} sets the output, {IP1dB (dBm)} sets the input, {OP1dB (dBm)} sets the output, {IPsat (dBm)} sets the input saturation, {OPsat (dBm)} sets the output, {Simulate using} sets the type, {Plot power characteristics}, {Lookup table (Pin(dBm), Pout(dBm), deg)} sets the lookup table -10, 20, -2; {Output saturation level (V)}, {Magnitude smoothness factor}, {Phase gain (rad)}, {Phase saturation}, {Phase smoothness factor}, {Input scaling (dB)} sets the scaling factor for input signal level, {AM / AM parameters [alpha beta]} sets the aM/AM conversion parameters, {AM / PM parameters [alpha beta]} sets the aM/PM conversion parameters, {Output scaling (dB)} sets the scaling factor for output signal level, {Include Noise} adds noise to system, {Noise temperature (K)} sets the noise temperature to model noises, {Noise figure (dB)} sets the noise figure to model noise in amplifier 10 *, {Noise factor}, {Seed source} sets the source of initial seed and {Seed}. Values come from the instance.
